versions.name: Camp Constantin / Jack D. Furst Aquatic Base

features.note: The dining hall is air conditioned.
A combined chapel and amphitheatre seating over seven hundred.
The Trail to First Class program area.
Striper and bass in the lake.
A fleet of ski boats at the Jack D. Furst Aquatic Base, the programme the camp is best known for.
Six miles of shoreline on Possum Kingdom Lake, one of Scouting's largest waterfront areas.

versions.summary: Circle Ten Council's Scouts BSA resident summer camp on Possum Kingdom Lake, including the Jack D. Furst Aquatic Base.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Website repaired 2026-07-25: the stored link was a registration portal (https://scoutingevent.com/571-2026SummerCampCON); replaced with the council's own camp page, found by tools/find_camp_pages.py and confirmed to name the camp. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence). That page is a client-rendered app, so it needs a real browser rather than a plain fetch.
